field.label: Name
field.help: For example "6-9 years", "10-12 years" or "13-15 years".

field.label: Enforce SafeSearch
field.help: AdGuard Home only: search engines (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, YouTube, Yandex, Ecosia, Pixabay) are put in safe mode.

field.label: Adult content filter
field.help: AdGuard Home only: enables the parental control filter (adult websites).

field.label: Block categories
field.help: AdGuard Home only: blocks well-known services in these categories.

field.label: Groups in the filter backend
field.help: Pi-hole only: names of existing Pi-hole groups (comma separated) to which the devices of the group are added. Attach the blocklists (for example for adult content) to those groups in Pi-hole itself.

field.label: Extra blocked domains
field.help: Comma separated. Subdomains are blocked as well.

field.label: Always allowed domains
field.help: Comma separated. Overrides blocks from the filter lists for this group.
